shadows.name: navigation-lift
shadows.purpose: Separate the fixed topbar from page content.

shadows.name: action-lift
shadows.purpose: Give the primary action clear priority.

shadows.name: proof-lift
shadows.purpose: Lift real product windows and source demonstrations.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and active state changes.

motion.name: authored-entrance
motion.purpose: One page-level entrance for the primary proof surface.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on marketing and guide surfaces.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #0a397f; color: #f7f9fb; font: 610 0.92rem/1 Manrope, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 9px 24px rgba(8,43,99,.24); transition: background 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #061f4a; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(8,43,99,.3); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a4a9c; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: A secondary route that stays inside the reading flow.
components.css: .ds-text-action { color: #31577f; font: 520 .91rem/1.5 Manrope, sans-serif; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-text-action:hover { color: #082b63; text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a4a9c; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Topbar
components.description: The fixed navigation surface shared by every website route.
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; min-height: 64px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.66); border-radius: 18px; background: rgba(239,247,252,.92); color: #082b63; font: 520 .9rem/1 Manrope, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 12px 34px rgba(8,43,99,.12); } .ds-topbar:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #0a4a9c; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Source Panel
components.description: A dark surface for Markdown, commands, and source-preserving output.
components.css: .ds-source { margin: 0; padding: 28px; border-radius: 16px; background: #071c3d; color: #d9e8f8; font: 500 .78rem/1.75 "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(8,43,99,.16); white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Release Badge
components.description: A compact version and freshness indicator in the topbar.
components.css: .ds-release { display: inline-flex; min-height: 30px; align-items: center; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(8,43,99,.24); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.54); color: #082b63; font: 500 .72rem/1 "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; }

narrative.overview: The website feels like a bright workspace where project files, documentation, and tools remain visible together. Large direct typography establishes the idea. Real product surfaces and precise source-file geometry provide proof.
keyCharacteristics: Large Manrope headlines with compact line height.
Light-blue page fields and deep-blue text.
Real viewer captures, terminal surfaces, and authored source diagrams.
Generous editorial spacing with restrained controls.

rules.name: The Blue Field Rule
rules.body: Use blue as a page-scale field or a clear action. Do not scatter blue as unrelated decoration.

rules.name: The One Large Thought Rule
rules.body: Let one headline dominate each major field. Do not compete with parallel headings at the same scale.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Keep prose and lists flat. Reserve elevation for objects that represent an interface or an action.

dos: Do show real source files, viewer states, and terminal output.
Do vary page rhythm between large fields, quiet prose, and product proof.
Do keep one source path or command readable when a technical visual is central.
Do use SVG icons from the established stroke system.
donts: Don't turn the page into a grid of interchangeable feature cards.
Don't use monospace as decoration outside code, paths, versions, or data.
Don't invent customer proof, benchmarks, or product behavior.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glass, or a second accent palette.
